name: Data Lab
description: Data-driven demo and test bench. Eight pages show how one demo renders tables, grouped positions, time series, joined exceptions and a lazily loaded trade history from five interchangeable data sets — and measures where the limits are.

dataSets.name: Tier 1 bank
dataSets.description: Base data set: 400 trades, 6 desks, 260-day series, exceptions with lifecycle events and a 20,000-row CSV history.

dataSets.name: Regional broker (DE)
dataSets.description: Extends Tier 1 bank: own trades, positions and exceptions in EUR / de-DE; inherits the series and history file.

dataSets.name: Asset manager (UK)
dataSets.description: Extends Tier 1 bank with a 15-line override: new client, GBP / en-GB and two KPIs. Everything else is inherited.

dataSets.name: Stress test
dataSets.description: Near the limits: 2,600 inline trades (~900 KB), 1,000-point series, 180 exceptions and a 100,000-row CSV history.

dataSets.name: Edge cases
dataSets.description: Nulls, blanks, negative and zero values, long unicode names, HTML in text and empty arrays — every page should degrade gracefully.
